headline: Huawei maps 1.4nm-class chips by 2031; a quiet day
body: A quiet day. Huawei laid out a roadmap to 1.4nm-class chip density by 2031 despite export controls, a small push to Capability Velocity that slightly lifts Enslaved God and Descendants and trims Reversion. Spain approved a draft AI law aligned with the EU AI Act. Horizon Balance is unchanged at 0.5.
movers_note: Reversion -0.1, Enslaved God +0.1 and Descendants +0.1, each mostly from Huawei's chip roadmap (-0.12/+0.12/+0.12).
